# Six rings: a great ruin or a Fragment site; three for the rest
DA_RX_deep = {
	OR = {
		DA_RX_great = yes
		DA_RX_fragment = yes
	}
}
# The Temple Complex's own rings (a complex that is also a great ruin keeps the city's)
DA_RX_temple_rings = {
	DA_RX_temple = yes
	NOT = { DA_RX_deep = yes }
}
# The deepest ring the owner may reach here (DA_LZ, doc 73: in a lizardfolk city, DA_RX_lz_room)
DA_RX_room = {
	OR = {
		AND = {
			NOT = { DA_RX_lz = yes }
			OR = {
				AND = {
					owner = { DA_EL_heritage = yes }
					DA_RX_deep = yes
					NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 6 } }
				}
				AND = {
					owner = { DA_EL_heritage = yes }
					NOT = { DA_RX_deep = yes }
					NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 3 } }
				}
				AND = {
					owner = { NOT = { DA_EL_heritage = yes } }
					NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 1 } }
				}
				AND = {
					owner = { NOT = { DA_EL_heritage = yes } }
					owner = { has_country_flag = DA_translator_found }
					NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 3 } }
				}
				AND = {	# DA_EL (doc 72): gnomes with Gommo Surveys
					owner = { NOT = { DA_EL_heritage = yes } DA_GN_surveys = yes }
					NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 3 } }
				}
			}
		}
		AND = {
			DA_RX_lz = yes
			DA_RX_lz_room = yes
		}
	}
}

	OR = {
		AND = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 0 } owner = { treasury = 100 } }
		AND = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 1 } owner = { treasury = 200 } }
		AND = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 2 } owner = { treasury = 400 } }
		AND = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 3 } owner = { treasury = 800 } }
		AND = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 4 } owner = { treasury = 1600 } }
		AND = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 5 } owner = { treasury = 3200 } }
	}
}

# A stratum here the owner may dig: not while the galleries are flooded; Arskitse only under the sea; every stratum
# for a lizardfolk heritage, strata I-II for anyone else
DA_RX_lz_room = {
	NOT = { has_province_modifier = DA_RX_lz_flooded }
	OR = {
		NOT = { DA_RX_lz_water = yes }
		owner = { OR = { has_country_modifier = DA_LZ_trait_gills has_country_modifier = DA_LZ_trait_gills_echo has_country_flag = DA_PR_done.LZ_Ars2 } }
	}
	OR = {
		AND = { owner = { DA_LZ_heritage = yes } NOT = { DA_RX_lz_full = yes } }
		AND = { owner = { NOT = { DA_LZ_heritage = yes } } NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_RX_ring value = 2 } } }
	}
}
